findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_creators, get_job, get_request · Private data: find_creators, request_outreach · Public sink: find_creators, get_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_creators, get_job, get_request · Private data: find_creators, request_outreach · Public sink: find_creators, get_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
